description: ASP.NET Core integration for **Lyo.Diagnostic**: scoped **breadcrumb** trails per request and **exception recording** to the in-memory error inbox plus structured logging, without replacing your existing problem-details middleware.

examples.title: Installation
Breadcrumbs in a controller

sections.title: Pipeline ordering
items: This middleware sits **closer to route handlers** and runs **first when an exception unwinds**.
It **records** the failure and calls **`IStructuredLogEnricher`**, then **rethrows**.
Outer middleware can still build **Problem Details** / HTTP error bodies.

sections.title: Options (`DiagnosticWebOptions`)
rows: Only occurrences at or above this severity are written to the inbox.
When `false`, expected control-flow classifications are skipped.
Headers tried in order for `RequestMetadata.CorrelationId`; falls back to `TraceIdentifier`.

sections.title: Breadcrumbs in a controller
sections.body:
Inject `IBreadcrumbTrail` (scoped) and add entries before risky work:



Do **not** put secrets or PII in breadcrumb data. See the **`Lyo.Diagnostic`** README.

sections.title: Lyo.Api
sections.text: `Lyo.Api` exposes **`AddLyoApiDiagnosticRecording`** as a convenience wrapper around **`AddLyoDiagnosticsWeb`**.
